notes.title: What Drives Zombie Ship? Our Inspirations & Vision
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45564257/aff86c6cd369a55de686ba7c641d6be73b15f24d.jpg[/img]

[i]Zombie Ship[/i] is more than just classic survival horror - we want to share what truly fuels the heart of our game.

Our biggest inspiration? The gritty, high-contrast noir atmosphere of [i]Sin City[/i]. We’ve blended this with moody science fiction, a fascination with maritime mysteries, and real-life shipwreck stories. The result is a unique mix of horror, suspense, and style that we hope you’ll feel from the very first moment you step aboard.

To capture that authentic noir comic book-inspired vibe, we brought in a Hollywood voice legend whose narration style echoes [i]Sin City[/i]’s iconic tone. (You might recognize him from some of your favorite games and movies!) 

Above is an early concept sketch that helped shape the look and feel of [i]Zombie Ship[/i].

Curious about our creative process, inspirations, or design choices? Ask away in the comments or join the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3628400/discussions/0/594023852480204336/]Q&A thread[/url] - we’re excited to chat with you!

[h1]The Ship’s Log: Course Set[/h1]

The ship knows where it’s headed. Here’s what it’s whispering to us:

[list]
[*][b]June:[/b] You’ll see the first movements - gameplay surfaces.
[*][b]July:[/b] Weapons systems come online - combat revealed.
[*][b]August:[/b] New crew wanted - closed alpha sign-ups.
[*][b]Fall:[/b] The ship grows - more rooms, more threats, more secrets.
[/list]

[i]Plans may change if the ship decides otherwise. Stay tuned.[/i]

notes.title: Welcome to the Ship of No Return
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45564257/a3d53755b0183e19fb258f18dd9b454cb409c48b.jpg[/img]

We’re [b]Deep Flame[/b], and this is [i]Zombie Ship[/i] - a sci-fi survival horror set adrift in the void, where the dead walk and the ship itself hungers for more than just souls.

[hr][/hr]

Right now, we’re buried deep in the guts of development: forging core gameplay, sketching out shadow-drenched corridors, and pushing our combat systems to the breaking point. Every deck creaks with secrets. Every bulkhead watches. The ship has its own agenda - and it doesn’t care who survives.

[hr][/hr]

We’ll use this space to show you the real story: raw progress, behind-the-scenes glimpses, and unfiltered updates from the heart of the storm.

[hr][/hr]

[i]If you want to know what happens next - if you’re ready to face the dark -[/i]
[b]add Zombie Ship to your wishlist and stay close.[/b]
